Manager (P&IR), Jawahar Tower. The last date to submit the application is 23 November 2026. content_sections.heading: SMPA Sr. Asstt. Manager at a Glance

rows.details: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata (Haldia Dock Complex)
Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be forwarded through proper channel along with all required documents, superscribing the envelope as “Application for the post of Sr. Asstt. Manager under MM Division, HDC, SMPA on Absorption / Deputation” . Send applications to the following postal address: Office of Sr. Dy. Manager (P&IR), Jawahar Tower, P.O.- Haldia Township, Dist.- Purba Medinipur, W.B, Pin — 721607

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering from a recognised University / Institution. Desirable Qualifications: Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in Materials Management from a recognised University / Institution. Five years post qualification experience in Materials Management in an Industrial / Commercial / Govt. Undertaking. Upper Age Limit: 35 years for Direct Recruitment (Absorption / Deputation applies to officers holding analogous posts or feeder posts with regular service as specified in the recruitment rules). content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each page. Self-certified photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience. No objection certificate issued by the competent authority from the respective Port (Annexure-IV). Undertaking of the applicant that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected. Vigilance and administrative clearance from the concerned Port (Annexure-V). Two passport size colour photographs. Complete service details of the applicant with posts held till date, certified by an Officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is by merit with a benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs / APARs of "Good". Absorption / Deputation will be initially for 03 years, extendable up to 04 years, and in exceptional circumstances up to 05 years.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for SMPA Sr. Asstt. Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to reach the office of Sr. Dy. Manager (P&IR) is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Sr. Asstt. Manager post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a pay scale of Rs. 50,000 - 1,60,000/- (pre-revised Rs. 10,750 - 16,750/-).

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Indian Nationals employed in any Major Port who hold a Degree or equivalent in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and meet the absorption or deputation criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What desirable qualifications are mentioned in the notice?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include a Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Materials Management from a recognised University or Institution, and five years post qualification experience in Materials Management in an Industrial, Commercial, or Government Undertaking.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach attested copies of APARs for the last 5 years, self-certified photocopies of educational and experience certificates, a no-objection certificate, an undertaking not to withdraw candidature, vigilance clearance, two passport size photographs, and complete service details certified by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD.
